title: Classify expense lines into budget categories with precedence rules
notes: 32 lines; each has exactly one label once the precedence rules are applied. Trap lines: hotel breakfast, client dinner and the in-flight sandwich are meals (P1); the course library subscription is training (P2); the conference ticket with lunch is training (P3); the docking station delivery charge is hardware while the contract courier and invoice postage are office (P4). Labels are compared case-insensitively; no tolerance.
